items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: I gave it back, gave those songs back to her.

ctx.x: Writer. Uh, newspaper. Lorraine Garou. Uh, yeah. Uh, she wrote the, like, the Society column, you know. Yeah. Or the, whatever. And, uh, and, uh, yeah. Yeah. Yeah. So I had Levy Music. And, uh, you know. And I don't know what ever happened to that because that was the only reason I ever had to have it. And, again, like I said, I gave it back, gave those songs back to her.
No, no, but my question is, it seems like, almost 100% of the writers and, and, uh, here went with BMI.
